description: This file defines the Reward model class in the Opencart e-commerce platform. The class manages reward points calculations, application to the order total, and reward point adjustments upon order confirmation and unconfirmation.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: Model class responsible for calculating reward point discounts, applying rewards to order totals, and managing reward point records during order confirmation and unconfirmation.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates and applies reward point discounts to the order total, adjusts taxes accordingly, and appends the reward discount to the order totals array.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Confirms the reward points used for an order, updating the customer's reward point balance, or returning a fraud status if insufficient points.

methods.name: unconfirm
methods.description: Removes reward point records associated with an order when the order is canceled or unconfirmed.
